Hitting Data for Ernie Clement in the 2025 Season through the End of June.

Source: R/data.R
clement_hits.Rd

Ernie Clement's hitting data for each hit that was put into the field of play (whether or not the result of the play was an out).

Usage

clement_hits

Format

A tibble object with 240 rows and 7 columns:

  • id: an identification number.

  • plate_x: the x-coordinate of where the ball crossed the plate during contact (in feet). A negative value indicates a pitch that is left of the center (from the perspective of the catcher) while a positive value indicates a pitch that is right of the center (from the perspective of the catcher).

  • plate_z: The vertical coordinate of where the ball crosses home plate, measured in feet from the ground.

  • launch_speed: The speed of the ball off of Clement's bat, in miles per hour.

  • bb_type: A factor representing the type of hit with levels fly_ball, ground_ball, line_drive, and popup.

  • pitch_type: A factor representing the type of pitch with levels CH (change-up or euphus), CU (curveball or knuckle curve or slurve), FC (fastball cutter), FF (four-seam fastball), FS (splitter), SI (sinker), SL (slider), and ST (sweeping slider).

  • release_speed: the speed (in miles per hour) at which the pitch was released.

Source

Data were obtained for non-commercial use from the statcast search on the baseball savant website https://baseballsavant.mlb.com/statcast_search. Statcast is maintained by the MLB.

References

MLB Advanced Media. (2025). Baseball Savant: Statcast search [Ernie Clement]. Baseball Savant.
